import YulangClosure.HigherOrderGraphObservation

/-! Candidate raw execution for every accepted higher-order graph constructor.
Graph lookup is an actual transition. No raw rule assumes typing or canonical
forms; receipts, paths and views remain uninterpreted retained metadata. -/
namespace YulangClosure.HigherOrderGraph.Safety
open YulangClosure.HigherOrderGraph
open HigherOrder (Ty Context emptyContext extend ViewOccurrence ReceiptTemplate
  OperationInstance PathCorrespondence)
variable {R : Type} {xi : R → Ty} {graph : Graph R}

def single (v : Value R Empty) : Nat → Value R Empty
  | 0 => v
  | n+1 => .var n

theorem substitute_top (hb : CompTyped xi emptyTy (extend env a) body b) (hv : ValueTyped xi emptyTy env v a) :
    CompTyped xi emptyTy env (substComp (single v) body) b := by
  apply substComp_typed hb
  intro i t hi
  cases i with
  | zero =>
      simp only [extend, Option.some.injEq] at hi
      subst t
      exact hv
  | succ i => exact .var hi

/-- Source application evaluates the callee first. The argument is shifted out
of the fresh callee binder before being delayed. -/
def sourceApply (callee argument : Comp R Empty) : Comp R Empty :=
  .bind callee (.dynamicCall (.var 0) (.delay (renameComp Nat.succ argument)))

theorem sourceApply_typed (hf : CompTyped xi emptyTy env callee (.callable a b))
    (ha : CompTyped xi emptyTy env argument a) : CompTyped xi emptyTy env (sourceApply callee argument) b :=
  .bind hf (.dynamicCall (.var rfl) (.delay (renameComp_typed ha (fun _ _ h => h))))

/-- Projection used only for a typed computation construction. Full adapters
remain in the plans below; this is not operational metadata erasure. -/
def adapterBody : Adapter R Empty → Comp R Empty
  | .mk _ _ body _ _ => body

theorem adapterBody_typed (h : AdapterTyped xi emptyTy env adapter a b) :
    CompTyped xi emptyTy (extend env a) (adapterBody adapter) b := by
  cases h with
  | mk h => exact h

def applyAdapter (adapter : Adapter R Empty) (v : Value R Empty) : Comp R Empty :=
  substComp (single v) (adapterBody adapter)

theorem applyAdapter_typed (h : AdapterTyped xi emptyTy env adapter a b)
    (hv : ValueTyped xi emptyTy env v a) : CompTyped xi emptyTy env (applyAdapter adapter v) b :=
  substitute_top (adapterBody_typed h) hv

def consumeResult (body : Comp R Empty) (consumer : Adapter R Empty) : Comp R Empty :=
  .bind body (adapterBody consumer)

theorem consumeResult_typed (hb : CompTyped xi emptyTy env body b)
    (hc : AdapterTyped xi emptyTy env consumer b r) : CompTyped xi emptyTy env (consumeResult body consumer) r :=
  .bind hb (adapterBody_typed hc)

/-- Value entry forces the carrier, then binds its value into the body. -/
def valueEntry (body : Comp R Empty) (carrier : Value R Empty) : Comp R Empty := .bind (.force carrier) body

theorem valueEntry_typed (hb : CompTyped xi emptyTy (extend env a) body b)
    (hc : ValueTyped xi emptyTy env carrier (.thunk a)) : CompTyped xi emptyTy env (valueEntry body carrier) b :=
  .bind (.force hc) hb

/-- Computation entry substitutes the carrier itself; no force is inserted. -/
def computationEntry (body : Comp R Empty) (carrier : Value R Empty) : Comp R Empty := substComp (single carrier) body

theorem computationEntry_typed (hb : CompTyped xi emptyTy (extend env (.thunk a)) body b)
    (hc : ValueTyped xi emptyTy env carrier (.thunk a)) : CompTyped xi emptyTy env (computationEntry body carrier) b :=
  substitute_top hb hc

structure LambdaEntryPlan (R : Type) where
  mode : Original.Mode
  receipt : ReceiptTemplate
  argument : Ty
  bodyResult : Ty
  result : Ty
  body : Comp R Empty
  consumer : Adapter R Empty
  carrier : Value R Empty

def LambdaEntryPlan.computation (p : LambdaEntryPlan R) : Comp R Empty :=
  consumeResult
    (match p.mode with
    | .value => valueEntry p.body p.carrier
    | .computation => computationEntry p.body p.carrier)
    p.consumer

theorem lambda_value_plan_typed (receipt : ReceiptTemplate)
    (hb : CompTyped xi emptyTy (extend env a) body b) (hc : AdapterTyped xi emptyTy env consumer b r)
    (ha : ValueTyped xi emptyTy env carrier (.thunk a)) :
    CompTyped xi emptyTy env (LambdaEntryPlan.computation
      ⟨.value, receipt, a, b, r, body, consumer, carrier⟩) r :=
  consumeResult_typed (valueEntry_typed hb ha) hc

theorem lambda_computation_plan_typed (receipt : ReceiptTemplate)
    (hb : CompTyped xi emptyTy (extend env (.thunk a)) body b) (hc : AdapterTyped xi emptyTy env consumer b r)
    (ha : ValueTyped xi emptyTy env carrier (.thunk a)) :
    CompTyped xi emptyTy env (LambdaEntryPlan.computation
      ⟨.computation, receipt, a, b, r, body, consumer, carrier⟩) r :=
  consumeResult_typed (computationEntry_typed hb ha) hc

/-- Input adaptation runs inside the delayed carrier. The output adapter runs
on the inner call's returned value. Entire adapter metadata is retained. -/
structure WrapEntryPlan (R : Type) where
  inner : Value R Empty
  input : Adapter R Empty
  output : Adapter R Empty
  carrier : Value R Empty

def WrapEntryPlan.computation (p : WrapEntryPlan R) : Comp R Empty :=
  consumeResult
    (.dynamicCall p.inner (.delay (.bind (.force p.carrier) (adapterBody p.input))))
    p.output

theorem wrap_plan_typed (hf : ValueTyped xi emptyTy env inner (.callable a b))
    (hi : AdapterTyped xi emptyTy env input c a) (ho : AdapterTyped xi emptyTy env output b d)
    (hc : ValueTyped xi emptyTy env carrier (.thunk c)) :
    CompTyped xi emptyTy env (WrapEntryPlan.computation ⟨inner, input, output, carrier⟩) d :=
  consumeResult_typed
    (.dynamicCall hf (.delay (.bind (.force hc) (adapterBody_typed hi)))) ho

/-- Complete annotations are retained as data, without claiming their semantic
adequacy. A view observation is an explicit transition, never silent erasure. -/
inductive Event (R : Type) where
  | silent
  | lookup (reference : R)
  | observeView (occurrence : ViewOccurrence)
  | lambdaEntry (plan : LambdaEntryPlan R)
  | wrapEntry (plan : WrapEntryPlan R)
  | leaveScope (owner : Nat)
  | leaveExpose (effectView resultView : ViewOccurrence)

/-- Independent operational rules: no rule contains a typing or safety premise.
Only the left side of bind and bodies of scope/expose are evaluation contexts. -/
inductive Step (graph : Graph R) : Comp R Empty → Event R → Comp R Empty → Prop where
  | forceRef : Step graph (.force (.ref r)) (.lookup r) (.force (graph r))
  | unionRef : Step graph (.unionCase (.ref r) l right) (.lookup r) (.unionCase (graph r) l right)
  | chooseLeftRef : Step graph (.chooseLeft (.ref r)) (.lookup r) (.chooseLeft (graph r))
  | chooseRightRef : Step graph (.chooseRight (.ref r)) (.lookup r) (.chooseRight (graph r))
  | absurdRef : Step graph (.absurd (.ref r)) (.lookup r) (.absurd (graph r))
  | callRef : Step graph (.dynamicCall (.ref r) arg) (.lookup r) (.dynamicCall (graph r) arg)
  | absurdView : Step graph (.absurd (.view v o)) (.observeView o) (.absurd v)
  | force : Step graph (.force (.delay body)) .silent body
  | forceView : Step graph (.force (.view v o)) (.observeView o) (.force v)
  | bindReturn : Step graph (.bind (.ret v) body) .silent (substComp (single v) body)
  | bind : Step graph m e n → Step graph (.bind m body) e (.bind n body)
  | unionLeft : Step graph (.unionCase (.inLeft v) l r) .silent (substComp (single v) l)
  | unionRight : Step graph (.unionCase (.inRight v) l r) .silent (substComp (single v) r)
  | unionView : Step graph (.unionCase (.view v o) l r) (.observeView o) (.unionCase v l r)
  | chooseLeft : Step graph (.chooseLeft (.both v)) .silent (.ret v)
  | chooseRight : Step graph (.chooseRight (.both v)) .silent (.ret v)
  | chooseLeftView : Step graph (.chooseLeft (.view v o)) (.observeView o) (.chooseLeft v)
  | chooseRightView : Step graph (.chooseRight (.view v o)) (.observeView o) (.chooseRight v)
  | scope : Step graph m e n → Step graph (.scope owner m) e (.scope owner n)
  | scopeReturn : Step graph (.scope owner (.ret v)) (.leaveScope owner) (.ret v)
  | expose : Step graph m e n → Step graph (.expose ev rv m) e (.expose ev rv n)
  | exposeReturn : Step graph (.expose ev rv (.ret v)) (.leaveExpose ev rv) (.ret v)
  | callView : Step graph (.dynamicCall (.view f o) arg) (.observeView o) (.dynamicCall f arg)
  | callLambda :
      Step graph (.dynamicCall (.lambda mode receipt a b r body consumer) carrier)
        (.lambdaEntry ⟨mode, receipt, a, b, r, body, consumer, carrier⟩)
        (LambdaEntryPlan.computation ⟨mode, receipt, a, b, r, body, consumer, carrier⟩)
  | callWrap :
      Step graph (.dynamicCall (.wrap inner input output) carrier)
        (.wrapEntry ⟨inner, input, output, carrier⟩)
        (WrapEntryPlan.computation ⟨inner, input, output, carrier⟩)

/-- Only explicit failure or an unhandled operation suspends execution. The
whole enclosing evaluation context and the original response binder remain. -/
inductive Suspended : Comp R Empty → Prop where
  | request (op payload continuation) : Suspended (.request op payload continuation)
  | fail (reason) : Suspended (.fail reason)
  | bind : Suspended m → Suspended (.bind m body)
  | scope : Suspended m → Suspended (.scope owner m)
  | expose : Suspended m → Suspended (.expose ev rv m)

inductive Returned : Comp R Empty → Prop where
  | ret (v : Value R Empty) : Returned (.ret v)

def CanProgress (m : Comp R Empty) : Prop :=
  Returned m ∨ Suspended m ∨ ∃ e n, Step graph m e n

theorem reference_type (h : ValueTyped xi emptyTy env (.ref r) a) : xi r = a := by
  cases h
  rfl

theorem preservation (hg : WellTyped graph xi) (step : Step graph m e n)
    (h : CompTyped xi emptyTy emptyContext m a) : CompTyped xi emptyTy emptyContext n a := by
  induction step generalizing a with
  | forceRef =>
      cases h with
      | force hv => exact .force ((reference_type hv) ▸ hg _)
  | unionRef =>
      cases h with
      | unionCase hv hl hr => exact .unionCase ((reference_type hv) ▸ hg _) hl hr
  | chooseLeftRef =>
      cases h with
      | chooseLeft hv => exact .chooseLeft ((reference_type hv) ▸ hg _)
  | chooseRightRef =>
      cases h with
      | chooseRight hv => exact .chooseRight ((reference_type hv) ▸ hg _)
  | absurdRef =>
      cases h with
      | absurd hv => exact .absurd ((reference_type hv) ▸ hg _)
  | callRef =>
      cases h with
      | dynamicCall hv ha => exact .dynamicCall ((reference_type hv) ▸ hg _) ha
  | absurdView =>
      cases h with
      | absurd hv => cases hv with | view hv => exact .absurd hv
  | force =>
      cases h with
      | force hv => cases hv with | delay hb => exact hb
  | forceView =>
      cases h with
      | force hv => cases hv with | view hv => exact .force hv
  | bindReturn =>
      cases h with
      | bind hv hb => cases hv with | ret hv => exact substitute_top hb hv
  | bind _ ih =>
      cases h with
      | bind hm hb => exact .bind (ih hm) hb
  | unionLeft =>
      cases h with
      | unionCase hv hl _ => cases hv with | inLeft hv => exact substitute_top hl hv
  | unionRight =>
      cases h with
      | unionCase hv _ hr => cases hv with | inRight hv => exact substitute_top hr hv
  | unionView =>
      cases h with
      | unionCase hv hl hr => cases hv with | view hv => exact .unionCase hv hl hr
  | chooseLeft =>
      cases h with
      | chooseLeft hv => cases hv with | both hl _ => exact .ret hl
  | chooseRight =>
      cases h with
      | chooseRight hv => cases hv with | both _ hr => exact .ret hr
  | chooseLeftView =>
      cases h with
      | chooseLeft hv => cases hv with | view hv => exact .chooseLeft hv
  | chooseRightView =>
      cases h with
      | chooseRight hv => cases hv with | view hv => exact .chooseRight hv
  | scope _ ih =>
      cases h with
      | scope hm => exact .scope (ih hm)
  | scopeReturn =>
      cases h with
      | scope hm => exact hm
  | expose _ ih =>
      cases h with
      | expose hm => exact .expose (ih hm)
  | exposeReturn =>
      cases h with
      | expose hm => exact hm
  | callView =>
      cases h with
      | dynamicCall hf ha => cases hf with | view hf => exact .dynamicCall hf ha
  | callLambda =>
      cases h with
      | dynamicCall hf ha =>
          cases hf with
          | lambdaValue hb hc => exact lambda_value_plan_typed _ hb hc ha
          | lambdaComputation hb hc => exact lambda_computation_plan_typed _ hb hc ha
  | callWrap =>
      cases h with
      | dynamicCall hf ha =>
          cases hf with
          | wrap hf hi ho => exact wrap_plan_typed hf hi ho ha

theorem closed_progress (hg : WellTyped graph xi)
    (guard : GuardedValueGraph.Guarded (projectGraph graph))
    (h : CompTyped xi emptyTy emptyContext m a) : CanProgress (graph := graph) m := by
  cases h with
  | ret _ => exact .inl (.ret _)
  | force hv =>
      obtain ⟨body, hh, _⟩ := thunk_observation (typed_observation hg guard hv)
      cases hh with
      | here => exact .inr (.inr ⟨_, _, .force⟩)
      | ref _ => exact .inr (.inr ⟨_, _, .forceRef⟩)
      | view _ => exact .inr (.inr ⟨_, _, .forceView⟩)
  | bind hm hb =>
      rcases closed_progress hg guard hm with hr | hs | ⟨e, n, step⟩
      · cases hr
        exact .inr (.inr ⟨_, _, .bindReturn⟩)
      · exact .inr (.inl (.bind hs))
      · exact .inr (.inr ⟨e, _, .bind step⟩)
  | unionCase hv hl hr =>
      rcases union_observation (typed_observation hg guard hv) with ⟨w, hh, _⟩ | ⟨w, hh, _⟩
      · cases hh with
        | here => exact .inr (.inr ⟨_, _, .unionLeft⟩)
        | ref _ => exact .inr (.inr ⟨_, _, .unionRef⟩)
        | view _ => exact .inr (.inr ⟨_, _, .unionView⟩)
      · cases hh with
        | here => exact .inr (.inr ⟨_, _, .unionRight⟩)
        | ref _ => exact .inr (.inr ⟨_, _, .unionRef⟩)
        | view _ => exact .inr (.inr ⟨_, _, .unionView⟩)
  | chooseLeft hv =>
      obtain ⟨w, hh, _, _⟩ := intersection_observation (typed_observation hg guard hv)
      cases hh with
      | here => exact .inr (.inr ⟨_, _, .chooseLeft⟩)
      | ref _ => exact .inr (.inr ⟨_, _, .chooseLeftRef⟩)
      | view _ => exact .inr (.inr ⟨_, _, .chooseLeftView⟩)
  | chooseRight hv =>
      obtain ⟨w, hh, _, _⟩ := intersection_observation (typed_observation hg guard hv)
      cases hh with
      | here => exact .inr (.inr ⟨_, _, .chooseRight⟩)
      | ref _ => exact .inr (.inr ⟨_, _, .chooseRightRef⟩)
      | view _ => exact .inr (.inr ⟨_, _, .chooseRightView⟩)
  | absurd hv => exact False.elim (bottom_empty hg guard hv)
  | scope hm =>
      rcases closed_progress hg guard hm with hr | hs | ⟨e, n, step⟩
      · cases hr
        exact .inr (.inr ⟨_, _, .scopeReturn⟩)
      · exact .inr (.inl (.scope hs))
      · exact .inr (.inr ⟨e, _, .scope step⟩)
  | expose hm =>
      rcases closed_progress hg guard hm with hr | hs | ⟨e, n, step⟩
      · cases hr
        exact .inr (.inr ⟨_, _, .exposeReturn⟩)
      · exact .inr (.inl (.expose hs))
      · exact .inr (.inr ⟨e, _, .expose step⟩)
  | request _ _ => exact .inr (.inl (.request _ _ _))
  | fail => exact .inr (.inl (.fail _))
  | dynamicCall hf ha =>
      obtain ⟨w, hh, ht⟩ := callable_observation (typed_observation hg guard hf)
      cases hh with
      | ref _ => exact .inr (.inr ⟨_, _, .callRef⟩)
      | view _ => exact .inr (.inr ⟨_, _, .callView⟩)
      | here =>
          cases ht with
          | lambdaValue _ _ => exact .inr (.inr ⟨_, _, .callLambda⟩)
          | lambdaComputation _ _ => exact .inr (.inr ⟨_, _, .callLambda⟩)
          | wrap _ _ _ => exact .inr (.inr ⟨_, _, .callWrap⟩)

theorem returned_no_step (h : Returned m) : ¬ Step graph m e n := by
  intro step
  cases h
  cases step

theorem suspended_no_step (h : Suspended m) : ¬ Step graph m e n := by
  intro step
  induction h generalizing e n with
  | request => cases step
  | fail => cases step
  | bind hs ih =>
      cases step with
      | bindReturn => cases hs
      | bind step => exact ih step
  | scope hs ih =>
      cases step with
      | scopeReturn => cases hs
      | scope step => exact ih step
  | expose hs ih =>
      cases step with
      | exposeReturn => cases hs
      | expose step => exact ih step

/-- Contexts capture only the actual evaluation positions; neither delayed
bodies nor request continuations are evaluated before their entry event. -/
inductive EvalContext (R : Type) where
  | hole
  | bind (inner : EvalContext R) (body : Comp R Empty)
  | scope (owner : Nat) (inner : EvalContext R)
  | expose (ev rv : ViewOccurrence) (inner : EvalContext R)

def EvalContext.plug : EvalContext R → Comp R Empty → Comp R Empty
  | .hole, m => m
  | .bind k body, m => .bind (k.plug m) body
  | .scope owner k, m => .scope owner (k.plug m)
  | .expose ev rv k, m => .expose ev rv (k.plug m)

inductive ContextTyped (xi : R → Ty) (env : Context) : EvalContext R → Ty → Ty → Prop where
  | hole : ContextTyped xi env .hole a a
  | bind : ContextTyped xi env k a b → CompTyped xi emptyTy (extend env b) body c →
      ContextTyped xi env (.bind k body) a c
  | scope : ContextTyped xi env k a b → ContextTyped xi env (.scope owner k) a b
  | expose : ContextTyped xi env k a b → ContextTyped xi env (.expose ev rv k) a b

theorem plug_typed (hk : ContextTyped xi env k a b) (hm : CompTyped xi emptyTy env m a) :
    CompTyped xi emptyTy env (k.plug m) b := by
  induction hk with
  | hole => exact hm
  | bind _ hb ih => exact .bind (ih hm) hb
  | scope _ ih => exact .scope (ih hm)
  | expose _ ih => exact .expose (ih hm)

theorem context_inversion (k : EvalContext R) (h : CompTyped xi emptyTy env (k.plug m) b) :
    ∃ a, CompTyped xi emptyTy env m a ∧ ContextTyped xi env k a b := by
  induction k generalizing b with
  | hole => exact ⟨_, h, .hole⟩
  | bind k body ih =>
      cases h with
      | bind hm hb =>
          obtain ⟨a, hm, hk⟩ := ih hm
          exact ⟨a, hm, .bind hk hb⟩
  | scope owner k ih =>
      cases h with
      | scope hm =>
          obtain ⟨a, hm, hk⟩ := ih hm
          exact ⟨a, hm, .scope hk⟩
  | expose ev rv k ih =>
      cases h with
      | expose hm =>
          obtain ⟨a, hm, hk⟩ := ih hm
          exact ⟨a, hm, .expose hk⟩

/-- A suspension has a concrete failure or request at a finite context hole.
This is not an extra rule declaring arbitrary stuck terms terminal. -/
theorem suspended_decomposition (h : Suspended m) :
    (∃ k : EvalContext R, ∃ reason, m = k.plug (.fail reason)) ∨
    (∃ k : EvalContext R, ∃ op payload continuation, m = k.plug (.request op payload continuation)) := by
  induction h with
  | request op payload continuation =>
      exact .inr ⟨.hole, op, payload, continuation, rfl⟩
  | fail reason => exact .inl ⟨.hole, reason, rfl⟩
  | bind _ ih =>
      rcases ih with ⟨k, reason, rfl⟩ | ⟨k, op, payload, continuation, rfl⟩
      · exact .inl ⟨.bind k _, reason, rfl⟩
      · exact .inr ⟨.bind k _, op, payload, continuation, rfl⟩
  | scope _ ih =>
      rcases ih with ⟨k, reason, rfl⟩ | ⟨k, op, payload, continuation, rfl⟩
      · exact .inl ⟨.scope _ k, reason, rfl⟩
      · exact .inr ⟨.scope _ k, op, payload, continuation, rfl⟩
  | expose _ ih =>
      rcases ih with ⟨k, reason, rfl⟩ | ⟨k, op, payload, continuation, rfl⟩
      · exact .inl ⟨.expose _ _ k, reason, rfl⟩
      · exact .inr ⟨.expose _ _ k, op, payload, continuation, rfl⟩

/-- The finite trace stores every emitted event in execution order. -/
inductive Steps (graph : Graph R) : Comp R Empty → List (Event R) → Comp R Empty → Prop where
  | refl (m) : Steps graph m [] m
  | cons : Step graph m e n → Steps graph n trace last → Steps graph m (e :: trace) last

theorem trace_preservation (hg : WellTyped graph xi) (steps : Steps graph m trace n)
    (h : CompTyped xi emptyTy emptyContext m a) : CompTyped xi emptyTy emptyContext n a := by
  induction steps generalizing a with
  | refl => exact h
  | cons step rest ih => exact ih (preservation hg step h)

/-- The finite canonical lookup is realized by actual raw reference/view
steps followed by the force rule. No assumed transition is used. -/
theorem force_observation_execution (h : Head graph v (.delay body)) :
    ∃ trace, Steps graph (.force v) trace body := by
  have aux : ∀ (v w : Value R Empty), Head graph v w →
      ∀ body, w = .delay body → ∃ trace, Steps graph (.force v) trace body := by
    intro v w observation
    induction observation with
    | here v =>
        intro body equal
        cases equal
        exact ⟨_, .cons .force (.refl _)⟩
    | ref _ ih =>
        intro body equal
        obtain ⟨trace, steps⟩ := ih body equal
        exact ⟨_, .cons .forceRef steps⟩
    | view _ ih =>
        intro body equal
        obtain ⟨trace, steps⟩ := ih body equal
        exact ⟨_, .cons .forceView steps⟩
  exact aux _ _ h body rfl

/-- Quantifies over every finite prefix, not a selected successful execution. -/
theorem finite_prefix_safety (hg : WellTyped graph xi)
    (guard : GuardedValueGraph.Guarded (projectGraph graph))
    (h : CompTyped xi emptyTy emptyContext m a) (steps : Steps graph m trace n) :
    CompTyped xi emptyTy emptyContext n a ∧ CanProgress (graph := graph) n := by
  have hn := trace_preservation hg steps h
  exact ⟨hn, closed_progress hg guard hn⟩

/-- An actual operation response remains independently quantified. -/
theorem resume_request_typed
    (h : CompTyped xi emptyTy env (.request op payload continuation) a)
    (response : Value R Empty) (hr : ValueTyped xi emptyTy env response op.responseType) :
    CompTyped xi emptyTy env (substComp (single response) continuation) a := by
  cases h with
  | request _ hk => exact substitute_top hk hr

/-- Independent response and enclosing-context quantifiers are both retained.
No local lambda action stands in for the foreign continuation. -/
theorem resume_in_context_typed (k : EvalContext R)
    (h : CompTyped xi emptyTy env (k.plug (.request op payload continuation)) a)
    (response : Value R Empty) (hr : ValueTyped xi emptyTy env response op.responseType) :
    CompTyped xi emptyTy env (k.plug (substComp (single response) continuation)) a := by
  obtain ⟨b, hm, hk⟩ := context_inversion k h
  exact plug_typed hk (resume_request_typed hm response hr)

/-- Viewed Force is represented explicitly, with the exact occurrence retained. -/
theorem viewed_force (v : Value R Empty) (o : ViewOccurrence) :
    Step graph (.force (.view v o)) (.observeView o) (.force v) := .forceView

/-- Computation entry passes the original thunk without forcing it. -/
theorem computation_entry_equation (receipt a b r body consumer) (carrier : Value R Empty) :
    (LambdaEntryPlan.mk .computation receipt a b r body consumer carrier).computation =
      .bind (substComp (single carrier) body) (adapterBody consumer) := rfl

/-- Value entry forces before body execution, then applies the result consumer. -/
theorem value_entry_equation (receipt a b r body consumer) (carrier : Value R Empty) :
    (LambdaEntryPlan.mk .value receipt a b r body consumer carrier).computation =
      .bind (.bind (.force carrier) body) (adapterBody consumer) := rfl

/-- Input adaptation is inside the delayed carrier; output adaptation waits for
an inner result. This equation rules out premature argument adaptation. -/
theorem wrap_entry_equation (inner : Value R Empty) (input output : Adapter R Empty) (carrier : Value R Empty) :
    (WrapEntryPlan.mk inner input output carrier).computation =
      .bind (.dynamicCall inner (.delay (.bind (.force carrier) (adapterBody input))))
        (adapterBody output) := rfl


/-- Concrete four-way alternative. Requests and failures are distinct finite
context decompositions; neither is an arbitrary stuck computation. -/
def Failed (m : Comp R Empty) : Prop := ∃ k : EvalContext R, ∃ reason, m = k.plug (.fail reason)
def Requested (m : Comp R Empty) : Prop :=
  ∃ k : EvalContext R, ∃ op payload continuation, m = k.plug (.request op payload continuation)

theorem progress_four (hg : WellTyped graph xi)
    (guard : GuardedValueGraph.Guarded (projectGraph graph))
    (h : CompTyped xi emptyTy emptyContext m a) :
    Returned m ∨ Requested m ∨ Failed m ∨ ∃ e n, Step graph m e n := by
  rcases closed_progress hg guard h with hr | hs | hn
  · exact .inl hr
  · rcases suspended_decomposition hs with hf | hq
    · exact .inr (.inr (.inl hf))
    · exact .inr (.inl hq)
  · exact .inr (.inr (.inr hn))

theorem context_suspended (k : EvalContext R) (h : Suspended m) : Suspended (k.plug m) := by
  induction k with
  | hole => exact h
  | bind _ _ ih => exact .bind ih
  | scope _ _ ih => exact .scope ih
  | expose _ _ _ ih => exact .expose ih

theorem failed_no_step (h : Failed m) : ¬ Step graph m e n := by
  obtain ⟨k, reason, rfl⟩ := h
  exact suspended_no_step (context_suspended k (.fail reason))

theorem requested_no_step (h : Requested m) : ¬ Step graph m e n := by
  obtain ⟨k, op, payload, continuation, rfl⟩ := h
  exact suspended_no_step (context_suspended k (.request op payload continuation))

/-- A request's original response binder and the independent outer evaluation
context are derived from the concrete suspended computation's typing. -/
theorem request_context_typing (k : EvalContext R)
    (h : CompTyped xi emptyTy emptyContext (k.plug (.request op payload continuation)) a) :
    ∃ b, ValueTyped xi emptyTy emptyContext payload op.payloadType ∧
      CompTyped xi emptyTy (extend emptyContext op.responseType) continuation b ∧
      ContextTyped xi emptyContext k b a := by
  obtain ⟨b, hb, hk⟩ := context_inversion k h
  cases hb with
  | request hp hc => exact ⟨b, hp, hc, hk⟩

/-- Parent application: actual source RHS and body derivations, independently
typed old captures, and the actual finite fresh-cycle criterion supply every
node observation and every finite internal prefix after simultaneous allocation.
There is no dynamic rec instruction in this accepted grammar. -/
theorem source_rec_execution {nu : Fin n → Ty}
    (hg : WellTyped graph xi) (guard : GuardedValueGraph.Guarded (projectGraph graph))
    (rhs : Fin n → HigherOrder.Value)
    (hrhs : ∀ s, HigherOrder.ValueTyped (sourceContext nu env) (rhs s) (nu s))
    (hcapture : CapturesTyped xi env capture)
    (hcycle : FreshNoCycle (sourceFresh capture rhs))
    (hbody : HigherOrder.CompTyped (sourceContext nu env) body a) :
    WellTyped (allocate graph (sourceFresh capture rhs)) (joinTy xi nu) ∧
    (∀ r, ObservedTyped (allocate graph (sourceFresh capture rhs)) (joinTy xi nu)
      (.ref r) (joinTy xi nu r)) ∧
    (∀ trace last, Steps (allocate graph (sourceFresh capture rhs))
      (sourceCloseComp capture n body) trace last →
      CompTyped (joinTy xi nu) emptyTy emptyContext last a ∧
      CanProgress (graph := allocate graph (sourceFresh capture rhs)) last) := by
  obtain ⟨ht, ⟨guard'⟩, hb⟩ := source_rec_allocation hg guard rhs hrhs hcapture hcycle hbody
  exact ⟨ht, (fun r => typed_observation ht guard' (.ref r)),
    (fun _ _ steps => finite_prefix_safety ht guard' hb steps)⟩

theorem finite_source_rec_execution {graph : Graph (Fin m)}
    {xi : Fin m → Ty} {nu : Fin n → Ty}
    (hg : WellTyped graph xi)
    (hOld : GuardedValueGraph.FiniteDecision.NoCycle (projectGraph graph))
    (rhs : Fin n → HigherOrder.Value)
    (hrhs : ∀ s, HigherOrder.ValueTyped (sourceContext nu env) (rhs s) (nu s))
    (hcapture : CapturesTyped xi env capture)
    (hcycle : FreshNoCycle (sourceFresh capture rhs))
    (hbody : HigherOrder.CompTyped (sourceContext nu env) body a) :
    WellTyped (allocate graph (sourceFresh capture rhs)) (joinTy xi nu) ∧
    (∀ r, ObservedTyped (allocate graph (sourceFresh capture rhs)) (joinTy xi nu)
      (.ref r) (joinTy xi nu r)) ∧
    (∀ trace last, Steps (allocate graph (sourceFresh capture rhs))
      (sourceCloseComp capture n body) trace last →
      CompTyped (joinTy xi nu) emptyTy emptyContext last a ∧
      CanProgress (graph := allocate graph (sourceFresh capture rhs)) last) :=
  source_rec_execution hg (GuardedValueGraph.FiniteDecision.guardOfNoCycle _ hOld)
    rhs hrhs hcapture hcycle hbody

/-- The explicit-name variant covers old references appearing in RHS code. -/
theorem named_rec_execution {nu : Fin n → Ty}
    (hg : WellTyped graph xi) (guard : GuardedValueGraph.Guarded (projectGraph graph))
    (rhs : Fin n → Value R (Fin n))
    (hrhs : ∀ s, ValueTyped xi nu env (rhs s) (nu s))
    (hcapture : CapturesTyped xi env capture)
    (hcycle : FreshNoCycle (fun s => closeValue capture (rhs s)))
    (hbody : CompTyped xi nu env body a)
    (steps : Steps (allocate graph (fun s => closeValue capture (rhs s)))
      (closeComp capture body) trace last) :
    CompTyped (joinTy xi nu) emptyTy emptyContext last a ∧
    CanProgress (graph := allocate graph (fun s => closeValue capture (rhs s))) last := by
  obtain ⟨ht, ⟨guard'⟩, hb⟩ := named_rec_allocation hg guard rhs hrhs hcapture hcycle hbody
  exact finite_prefix_safety ht guard' hb steps

namespace Examples
open YulangClosure.HigherOrderGraph.Examples

abbrev MutualRef := Sum (Fin 1) (Fin 2)
def mutualGraph : Graph MutualRef := allocate oldGraph mutualFresh
def carrier : Value MutualRef Empty := .delay (.ret .unit)
def callAt (s : Fin 2) : Comp MutualRef Empty := .dynamicCall (.ref (.inr s)) carrier
def callNode (s : Fin 2) : Comp MutualRef Empty := .dynamicCall (mutualFresh s) carrier
def consumerBody : Comp MutualRef Empty := .bind (.ret (.ref (.inl 0))) (.ret (.var 1))
def mutualPlan (s : Fin 2) : LambdaEntryPlan MutualRef :=
  ⟨.computation, receipt, unitTy, unitTy, unitTy,
    .bind (.ret (.ref (.inl 0))) (.dynamicCall (.ref (.inr (other s))) (.var 1)),
    .mk unitTy unitTy consumerBody [] [], carrier⟩
def entered (s : Fin 2) : Comp MutualRef Empty := (mutualPlan s).computation

theorem mutual_lookup (s : Fin 2) :
    Step mutualGraph (callAt s) (.lookup (.inr s)) (callNode s) := .callRef

theorem mutual_entry (s : Fin 2) :
    Step mutualGraph (callNode s) (.lambdaEntry (mutualPlan s)) (entered s) := by
  unfold callNode
  rw [mutualFresh_equation]
  exact .callLambda

theorem mutual_body_return (s : Fin 2) :
    Step mutualGraph (entered s) .silent (.bind (callAt (other s)) consumerBody) :=
  .bind .bindReturn

/-- Actual five-step prefix reaches the OTHER allocated lambda, retaining the
first result consumer. Recursive call/consumer accumulation is not collapsed. -/
theorem mutual_two_entries (s : Fin 2) :
    ∃ trace, Steps mutualGraph (callAt s) trace (.bind (entered (other s)) consumerBody) :=
  ⟨_, .cons (mutual_lookup s) (.cons (mutual_entry s)
    (.cons (mutual_body_return s) (.cons (.bind (mutual_lookup (other s)))
      (.cons (.bind (mutual_entry (other s))) (.refl _)))))⟩

def mutualSourceBody : HigherOrder.Comp := .dynamicCall (.var 0) (.delay (.ret .unit))

theorem mutualSourceBody_typed :
    HigherOrder.CompTyped (sourceContext (fun _ : Fin 2 => functionTy) outer)
      mutualSourceBody unitTy := .dynamicCall (.var rfl) (.delay (.ret .unit))

theorem mutual_source_closed : sourceCloseComp capture 2 mutualSourceBody = callAt 0 := rfl

/-- Source-derived safety for ALL finite prefixes of the actual recursive call,
not merely for the exhibited five steps. -/
theorem mutual_all_prefixes (steps : Steps mutualGraph (callAt 0) trace last) :
    CompTyped (joinTy oldTypes (fun _ : Fin 2 => functionTy)) emptyTy emptyContext last unitTy ∧
    CanProgress (graph := mutualGraph) last :=
  (source_rec_execution old_typed oldGuard mutualRhs mutualRhs_typed capture_typed
    mutualFresh_noCycle mutualSourceBody_typed).2.2 trace last steps

/-- Delayed recursive request uses the actual source response binder unchanged. -/
def requestFresh := sourceFresh capture (fun _ : Fin 1 => responseRhs)
def requestGraph := allocate oldGraph requestFresh
def requestSourceBody : HigherOrder.Comp := .force (.var 0)

theorem requestFresh_noCycle : FreshNoCycle requestFresh :=
  GuardedValueGraph.FiniteDecision.noCycle_of_terminal (fun _ => rfl)

theorem requestSourceBody_typed :
    HigherOrder.CompTyped (sourceContext (fun _ : Fin 1 => .thunk functionTy) outer)
      requestSourceBody functionTy := .force (.var rfl)

theorem request_two_steps :
    Steps requestGraph (sourceCloseComp capture 1 requestSourceBody)
      [.lookup (.inr 0), .silent]
      (.request operation (.ref (.inl 0))
        (.bind (.ret (.ref (.inr 0))) (.ret (.var 1)))) :=
  .cons .forceRef (.cons .force (.refl _))

theorem request_all_prefixes
    (steps : Steps requestGraph (sourceCloseComp capture 1 requestSourceBody) trace last) :
    CompTyped (joinTy oldTypes (fun _ : Fin 1 => .thunk functionTy)) emptyTy emptyContext last functionTy ∧
    CanProgress (graph := requestGraph) last :=
  (source_rec_execution old_typed oldGuard (fun _ : Fin 1 => responseRhs)
    (fun _ => responseRhs_typed) capture_typed requestFresh_noCycle requestSourceBody_typed).2.2 trace last steps

end Examples

end YulangClosure.HigherOrderGraph.Safety

independent wrapper adapters, and recursive references in code.

`source_rec_execution` applies the result immediately to the actual
`source_rec_allocation` theorem. Inputs are the old graph's typing/guard, common
source recursive RHS derivations, separately typed old captures, the actual
fresh transparent-cycle criterion, and the actual source body derivation.
Outputs include typed observation of every allocated reference and safety of
EVERY finite raw prefix from the actual `sourceCloseComp` body. There is no
per-fresh-node typing premise, fresh numeric rank oracle, or dynamic rec rule.
`finite_source_rec_execution` supplies the old guard from its finite NoCycle
criterion. `named_rec_execution` covers explicit old references in source RHS
code under the accepted explicit-name syntax.

The original full-paper theorem remains OPEN. This packet does not combine
handler and graph syntax, implement recursive μ types or type-changing roll,
cover every omitted paper form, or prove native readback/lifecycle semantics.
It proves internal prefix safety after actual immutable allocation. The local
response/context substitution theorem retains arbitrary independently typed
responses and arbitrary typed outer evaluation contexts, but does not pretend
to prove graph extension plus externally scheduled repeated interaction.

## Constructive observation

`ObservedTyped` is a finite derivation over the actual graph values. Reference
observation reads `graph r`; a view retains its occurrence; both/intersection
retains TWO observations of the same underlying value; top retains its actual
introduction; and wrap retains the original input/output adapters and their
inner/outer callable types. A wrapper from callable A B to callable C D never
claims that its inner callable has type callable C D. Lambda/delay/data stop
transparent observation and retain the real typed code or payload.

`observe_from_references` performs finite structural descent through actual
wrapper syntax. `typed_observation` supplies the reference case by induction
on the accepted guard rank bound. Its only edge conversion is the accepted
`projection_edge` equation; projection's Node.unit is ONLY a rank token, never
a canonical higher-order unit or a value-typing supplier. Both premises descend
independently; no intersection witness is discarded or merged.

`Head` is independent raw reference/view lookup. The typed thunk, callable,
union, intersection and top suppliers derive concrete introduction witnesses
through that lookup. Callable terminals keep lambda mode/body/consumer or the
complete wrapper and distinct adapter typings. `ObservedTyped.bottom_empty`
and `bottom_empty` exclude closed bottom inhabitants under exactly the graph
premises. Ref-type equalities are explicit in canonical inversions so that an
arbitrary Xi(r) is not treated as an injective syntax constructor.

The chain example follows a view/reference chain to `.both (.inLeft .unit)`
and retains its two different union typings. A separate wrapper example uses
unit→unit internally and bool→bool externally, and observes that callable
under top. The delayed self-reference example observes a genuine recursive
computation without claiming its body terminates. The previously accepted
actual source alias self-cycle rejection remains applicable unchanged.

## Independent raw execution and preservation

`Safety.Step` contains no typing, guard, canonical-form or safe-body premise.
Reference eliminators actually replace `.ref r` with `graph r` and record the
reference. Views have explicit steps. Lambda entry reconstructs the original
value/computation-mode conventions: value entry forces the delayed carrier,
computation entry substitutes the carrier itself, and the designated result
consumer belongs to its independent outer scope. Wrap input adaptation occurs
inside the delayed carrier and output adaptation runs after the inner result.
Raw entry events retain the complete lambda/adapter plans as data.

All accepted computation forms are covered. Return is terminal; request and
failure are explicit suspensions through finite bind/scope/expose contexts;
force, union and intersection eliminators execute their actual introductions;
absurd cannot be reached typed under the graph guard. Its raw reference/view
rules nevertheless have no typing premise. Bind evaluates only its first
computation; code bodies and response binders execute only on actual entry.

The candidate `preservation` theorem requires WellTyped but no Guarded premise.
The graph is immutable, and each actual lookup uses the declared reference type
and its original node typing. Closed progress additionally consumes Guarded
through typed observations and bottom exclusion. `trace_preservation` and
`finite_prefix_safety` quantify over every raw Steps derivation, without a
termination hypothesis. `progress_four`, `returned_no_step`,
`requested_no_step` and `failed_no_step` distinguish terminal alternatives from
actual transitions. Request decomposition and `request_context_typing` retain
the actual operation instance, payload, original response binder, and outer
context; `resume_in_context_typed` keeps the response independently quantified.

`force_observation_execution` additionally realizes a supplied thunk lookup as
an actual finite raw sequence of reference/view steps followed by force.

## Actual source constructions

`Examples.mutual_two_entries` uses the accepted `mutualRhs` allocation, not a
pretyped fresh-node oracle. Five raw steps enter one source lambda, consume its
shared old capture, look up the other allocated lambda, and enter that lambda
while retaining the first result consumer. Recursive consumer accumulation is
visible. `mutual_all_prefixes` applies `source_rec_execution` to the actual
source dynamic call and proves its arbitrary finite prefixes safe, not merely
the five displayed transitions.

`request_two_steps` forces the accepted allocated `responseRhs`. The resulting
request has the original operation instance, the shared old payload reference,
the recursive reference under the response continuation, and the unchanged
response index under its local bind. `request_all_prefixes` derives safety from
the actual source RHS/body/capture/guard premises. These are theorem instances;
the author did not run them as tests or claim native traces.

## Source/native boundary and implementation TODO

Read-only source inspection found two concrete incompatible lifecycle owners:

- `Machine::begin_local`, runtime/machine.rs 2500–2545, allocates a mutable None
  cell, extends the environment early for a recursive binding, schedules its
  initializer and applies initializer environment state.
- `Frame::Local`, runtime/machine.rs 1498–1560, publishes the received current
  value/dispatch/view into that cell and proceeds to the next binding.

These are actual producers/consumers, not the immutable simultaneous allocation
constructor proved here. Native execution also needs a relation for closure
captures, uninitialized reads and shared cell identity. Neither the raw graph
Step nor the source prefix-splitting equations establish that relation.
NO_SAFE_CODE_SLICE: the present packet is implementation-independent theory;
these owners have neither a proved complete realization relation nor a
production write lease in this packet.

A-NATIVE-1 / ENV-GRAPH-1, owner Luna/source intake: the minimal proposed
provisional instrument records allocated cell/binder identity, publication,
captured environment identity and actual lookup value while preserving explicit
uninitialized reads. Inputs are these exact owner paths and existing native
closure/environment evidence; proposed output is a source-qualified lifecycle
trace and a realization invariant. Falsifier: a captured read is uninitialized,
a current cell differs from its immutable readback, sharing yields inconsistent
types, or sequential initialization is asserted simultaneous without proof.
This is a TODO for later authorized work, not permission to edit production.

A-COMPOSE-1, owner Luna/theory intake: supply a single combined handler+graph
syntax and actual operations, preserving both accepted standalone embeddings,
before using this internal graph theorem for handler arena interaction.
Falsifier: a handler payload, response, saved continuation or adapter can contain
a graph reference that the proposed combined syntax/typing fails to represent.
HO-HANDLER-GRAPH-COMPOSITION-1 remains OPEN.

A-PAPER-1, owner full-paper theory intake: preserve the original paper's omitted
μ/roll, polymorphism and other forms; provide their actual source/operational
typing cases. Falsifier: an accepted paper term lacks a faithful translation or
a type-changing evidence wrapper is transported as type identity. OPEN.

A-CHECK-1, owner primary: serialize elaboration of the frozen bytes, query every
public declaration and full transitive axiom closure, then assign an eligible
fresh reviewer. Falsifier: failure to elaborate, omitted accepted constructor,
incorrect binder scope, forbidden axiom, hidden typing/canonical premise in raw
Step, changed guard/domain, or invalid reuse of a premise outside its source.
The author is not eligible to independently certify this result.

## Prior work, dependencies and resources

Reused within their exact premises: HigherOrderGraphSyntax structural substitution;
HigherOrderRecAllocation actual source construction, captures and allocation;
FiniteGuardDecision only for the projected transparent-edge criterion/rank;
and HigherOrderEntry/HigherOrderSafety as proof patterns reconstructed for graph
syntax with explicit new lookup cases. Restricted GuardedValueGraph NodeTyped,
transparent_type and canonical theorems are NOT reused as full higher-order

design_note_text:
# Higher-order research core and structural embedding

Status: Draft research construction; checking and review evidence is recorded in
the sprint outcome and its frozen receipts. This is not production authority.
Scope: frozen LEAN-HIGHER-ORDER-PROOF-CORE-20261025/r1 research representation.
Initial author: /root/higher_order_proof_core_astra_r1; requested gpt-6-astra/medium,
observed model/effort UNKNOWN. Primary /root repairs and integrates after author
STOP; the outcome records final authorship and independent review. No descendants.
Production authority: none. The operational paper is a proposal/target; the
2026-10-07 complete-Call definition §1 records permission for legitimate research
definitions, not adoption of this representation as compiler architecture.

The parent RESPONSE-ENCODING-1 / ENV-CALLABLE-1 lacked a callable constructor in
its formal Value sort. The candidate removes that specific representational
obstruction by constructing a new callable type and actual lambda/wrap values.
Every Original.Val/Comp and TypedCall.Value/Comp/Adapter/Function constructor is
mapped structurally. No old term is retained behind an opaque original opcode.
The full parent, native readback and operational safety remain OPEN.

## Syntax and quantifiers

`HigherOrderSyntax.lean` retains every old type constructor, all eight literal
domains and their exact payload representations, variables, delay, injections,
single-child intersection/top values and all seven Original computations. It
adds the existing Call view/scope/expose/request/fail nodes, lambda/wrap values,
and dynamicCall. Request's continuation binds its operation instance's response
type. The type language can place callable types beneath thunk/union/intersection
and in operation instances. The value, computation and adapter syntax is mutually
inductive; all typing judgments are defined afterwards.

Value-entry lambda binds A; computation-entry lambda binds Thunk A. Both retain
receipt, annotated input/body/result types, body and result consumer. Wrap keeps
the input adapter c→a and output adapter b→d around an a→b function. DynamicCall
accepts a thunk carrier. This fixes a research typing interface without asserting
an execution rule or operational equivalence for the new constructor.

`ContextEmbedding old new` quantifies over every old lookup fact. The mutual
Original and TypedCall preservation proofs quantify over arbitrary old terms,
old typing derivations and target contexts satisfying that relation. Closed
Original nodes embed under any target context using the empty lookup relation;
binders use `extend_embedding`. The Function theorem quantifies over every old
FunctionTyped derivation and every target context. No original constructor,
source-domain restriction or independent continuation quantifier is discarded.
This is one-way typing preservation, not reflection or full conservativity.

## Metadata boundary

Paths retain component lists, port kinds and translated endpoint types;
occurrences retain identities and paths. Operation instances retain operation
identity, ordered type arguments and both payload/response types. Receipt slots
and profiles retain order, identity and typed paths. Adapter metadata retains
all path correspondences and captured occurrences. Interface-port metadata also
has a structural map.

PathRule is a Prop in the accepted input. `embedPathRule` translates its proof
into a new Prop proof. It does not eliminate that proof into a data-valued map
identity. In particular the old permissive adapterMap rule remains permissive;
this work cannot prove that a mappingIdentity absent from runtime data can be
reconstructed. Syntax is **typing-proof-free**, not entirely proof-free. The old
Adapter.typed field is omitted from syntax and consumed solely to construct the
new extrinsic AdapterTyped derivation. The retained PathRule metadata neither
contains a typing judgment nor creates a typing-definition cycle.

## Parent application

`embedFunction_typed` constructs a ValueTyped callable from an old FunctionTyped
proof. `function_as_argument` and `call_with_function_argument` use it in the
actual new delayed argument and dynamicCall constructors.
`request_callable_response` constructs a request that binds and returns a
callable-typed response. `function_cell` pushes the embedded function into the
existing generic NativeClosureEnvironment.Store, proves the actual current cell
equality and supplies its callable typing derivation.

`read_embedding` preserves the exact old selected cell address while mapping the
current store pointwise. `read_embedding_typed` combines that equation with the
accepted `successful_read_typed` theorem. `captured_value_typed` applies the
accepted `realized_substitution_typed` supplier to each represented context index;
`captured_body_typed` applies its actual successful capture and closed-body
construction before embedding. Both keep successful realization and CellsTyped
as explicit original premises. Nothing claims that arbitrary native closures
already satisfy those premises, or that old stores already represent new
callable values. Generic new callable storage and old represented-read transport
are two separate constructions whose native connection is still open.

## Remaining source obligations and reuse

Accepted CoreSyntax typing and CallEnvironmentRealization supply precisely their
existing domains. CoreSubstitution's bind/request lifting is reused through
close_body, without reproving lookup or assuming a new substitution rule. The
NativeClosureEnvironment.Store remains generic; no machine fields change.
Historical literal readback is not extended to callable readback by analogy.
No failure is dismissed by a narrower theorem; no new source restriction,
Simple-sub bypass or production implementation is introduced.

Luna/source intake owns ENV-LAYOUT-1 (resolved free-variable order and binder
indices from source Lambda/Name/Apply), ENV-CELL-VALUE-1 (current native Value
encoding), ENV-GRAPH-1 (recursive cell/closure graphs), ENV-CALLABLE-1's remaining
native body/consumer mapping, and ENV-DISPATCH-1. Relevant native owners remain
machine.rs `Instruction::Lambda`, `Frame::ValueEntry`, `Machine::lookup`,
`Machine::extend`, closure/Callee branches and receiving.rs lambda schema
construction. The primary's disjoint source map gives their complete exact
producer/consumer inventory, including unit/record/default entry cases.
Force, native transitions, new-core substitution/progress/preservation,
whole-trace safety, operation authenticity and original inference A/B remain
OPEN. No F1/FK1 or foreign-continuation theorem is claimed here.

## Intake and checks

No Lean/build/tests/native checks were run by the author. A shell `python`
invocation failed because the executable was absent; the generation was then
performed with python3. This was a file-writing failure before any write, not a
failed proof check. Primary owns bounded elaboration, public signature/axiom
inspection, distinguishing examples, repairs after author STOP and fresh
independent review. Author/coauthor cannot independently certify this candidate.
Only the four exact leased files were created; there are no scratch paths,
background processes, descendants, compiler changes or Git operations.

namespace GraphEvidence
open YulangClosure.HigherOrder (Ty emptyContext)
open YulangClosure.HigherOrderGraph
open YulangClosure.HigherOrderGraph.Safety
open YulangClosure.HigherOrderGraph.ObservationExamples

theorem chainLeftTrace : Steps chainGraph (.chooseLeft (.ref false))
    [.lookup false, .observeView occurrence, .lookup true, .silent]
    (.ret (.inLeft .unit)) :=
  .cons .chooseLeftRef (.cons .chooseLeftView (.cons .chooseLeftRef (.cons .chooseLeft (.refl _))))

theorem chainLeftSafe : CompTyped chainTypes emptyTy emptyContext (.ret (.inLeft .unit)) leftTy ∧
    CanProgress (graph := chainGraph) (.ret (.inLeft .unit)) :=
  finite_prefix_safety chain_typed chainGuard (.chooseLeft (.ref false)) chainLeftTrace

theorem chainRightTrace : Steps chainGraph (.chooseRight (.ref false))
    [.lookup false, .observeView occurrence, .lookup true, .silent]
    (.ret (.inLeft .unit)) :=
  .cons .chooseRightRef (.cons .chooseRightView (.cons .chooseRightRef (.cons .chooseRight (.refl _))))

theorem chainRightSafe : CompTyped chainTypes emptyTy emptyContext (.ret (.inLeft .unit)) rightTy ∧
    CanProgress (graph := chainGraph) (.ret (.inLeft .unit)) :=
  finite_prefix_safety chain_typed chainGuard (.chooseRight (.ref false)) chainRightTrace

theorem delayLoop : Steps delayGraph (.force (.ref 0)) [.lookup 0, .silent] (.force (.ref 0)) :=
  .cons .forceRef (.cons .force (.refl _))

def wrapPlan : WrapEntryPlan Bool := ⟨inner, input, output, .delay (.ret (.bool false))⟩

theorem wrappedStep : Step wrapGraph (.dynamicCall wrapped (.delay (.ret (.bool false))))
    (.wrapEntry wrapPlan) wrapPlan.computation := .callWrap

theorem wrappedSafety : CompTyped wrapTypes emptyTy emptyContext wrapPlan.computation boolTy :=
  preservation wrap_typed wrappedStep (.dynamicCall (wrap_typed false) (.delay (.ret .bool)))

example (execution : Steps delayGraph (.force (.ref 0)) events last) :
    CompTyped delayTypes emptyTy emptyContext last unitTy ∧ CanProgress (graph := delayGraph) last :=
  finite_prefix_safety delay_typed delayGuard (.force (.ref 0)) execution
example : ¬ ValueTyped delayTypes emptyTy emptyContext (.ref 0) .bottom :=
  fun h => bottom_empty delay_typed delayGuard h
example : ∃ w, Head wrapGraph (.ref false) w ∧ CallableTerminal wrapTypes w boolTy boolTy :=
  callable_observation wrapped_observed
example : (Ty.callable unitTy unitTy) ≠ Ty.callable boolTy boolTy := distinct_wrap_types
end GraphEvidence

namespace HandlerEvidence
open YulangClosure.HigherOrder.Handler
open YulangClosure.HigherOrder.Handler.Interaction

example : StateTyped ⟨.ret (.bool true), [pendingSaved], .running⟩ boolType ∧
    Progress ⟨.ret (.bool true), [pendingSaved], .running⟩ :=
  pending_complete_safe (.bool true) .bool
example : StateTyped ⟨.ret (.bool true), [pendingSaved], .running⟩ boolType ∧
    Progress ⟨.ret (.bool true), [pendingSaved], .running⟩ :=
  pending_complete_safe (.bool false) .bool
example : ¬ RawStep (initial selectedProgram) (.publish 0 forwardedSaved) t :=
  handler_cannot_publish selectedHandler (.request unitOperation .unit (.ret (.var 0))) [] .running
example : ¬ Protocol ⟨bottomSaved.request, [bottomSaved], .waiting 0⟩

for every actual graph, graph typing and accepted transparent-edge guard, every
closed typed graph value has a finite typed observation; every raw internal
step preserves closed computation typing; and every finite raw internal prefix
of a closed typed computation ends typed and has a concrete return, request,

handler and graph syntax, implement recursive μ types or type-changing roll,

response/context substitution theorem retains arbitrary independently typed
responses and arbitrary typed outer evaluation contexts, but does not pretend
to prove graph extension plus externally scheduled repeated interaction.

## Constructive observation

`ObservedTyped` is a finite derivation over the actual graph values. Reference
observation reads `graph r`; a view retains its occurrence; both/intersection
retains TWO observations of the same underlying value; top retains its actual
introduction; and wrap retains the original input/output adapters and their
inner/outer callable types. A wrapper from callable A B to callable C D never
claims that its inner callable has type callable C D. Lambda/delay/data stop
transparent observation and retain the real typed code or payload.

wrapper syntax. `typed_observation` supplies the reference case by induction
on the accepted guard rank bound. Its only edge conversion is the accepted
`projection_edge` equation; projection's Node.unit is ONLY a rank token, never
a canonical higher-order unit or a value-typing supplier. Both premises descend
independently; no intersection witness is discarded or merged.

`Head` is independent raw reference/view lookup. The typed thunk, callable,
union, intersection and top suppliers derive concrete introduction witnesses
through that lookup. Callable terminals keep lambda mode/body/consumer or the
complete wrapper and distinct adapter typings. `ObservedTyped.bottom_empty`
and `bottom_empty` exclude closed bottom inhabitants under exactly the graph
premises. Ref-type equalities are explicit in canonical inversions so that an

and retains its two different union typings. A separate wrapper example uses

under top. The delayed self-reference example observes a genuine recursive
computation without claiming its body terminates. The previously accepted
actual source alias self-cycle rejection remains applicable unchanged.

## Independent raw execution and preservation

`Safety.Step` contains no typing, guard, canonical-form or safe-body premise.
Reference eliminators actually replace `.ref r` with `graph r` and record the
reference. Views have explicit steps. Lambda entry reconstructs the original
value/computation-mode conventions: value entry forces the delayed carrier,
computation entry substitutes the carrier itself, and the designated result
consumer belongs to its independent outer scope. Wrap input adaptation occurs
inside the delayed carrier and output adaptation runs after the inner result.
Raw entry events retain the complete lambda/adapter plans as data.

All accepted computation forms are covered. Return is terminal; request and
failure are explicit suspensions through finite bind/scope/expose contexts;

absurd cannot be reached typed under the graph guard. Its raw reference/view
rules nevertheless have no typing premise. Bind evaluates only its first

Raw internal steps, publication and response are defined without typing facts.
The separate Protocol requires exact FULL operation-instance equality and a
closed response of that entry's own response type. Identity, ordered type
arguments, payload type and response type are all in the compared instance.
Wrong instances and missing handles are rejected by independent lemmas. Capture
preservation uses root inversion; response preservation uses the saved entry's
actual continuation substitution. Finite trace induction then establishes the
invariant. Progress distinguishes actual outer return, actual outer failure,
coherent published waiting state, or a concrete admissible next transition.
Bottom responses are not postulated: a typed bottom request can be captured and
wait, while `bottom_response_unavailable` excludes any admissible response.

Scheduling deliberately follows frozen HigherOrder.Interaction: ANY existing
handle may replace the current branch in either running or waiting phase,
including after termination of another branch. Reuse never consumes an entry.
An earlier saved handle can therefore be selected after a newer publication.
This is the prior research arena interface, not a theorem about native scheduler
permissions. The theorem assumes independently typed supplied responses rather
than claiming a native parser/host produces them. Metadata is retained syntax;
retention is not activation freshening, permission validity or effect hygiene.

- `callback_capture_response` publishes a callable-response request, accepts the

  body and result consumer both contain handler syntax. `callback_actual_entry`

- `value_wait_capture` uses the distinct actual valueRequest propagation step.
  `value_wait_saved_response_safe` applies the captured-handle theorem to every

These constructions are proof terms awaiting primary elaboration, not executed

This packet does not touch source constraint generation, accumulation,

# Higher-order research core and structural embedding

Status: Draft research construction; checking and review evidence is recorded in
the sprint outcome and its frozen receipts. This is not production authority.
Scope: frozen LEAN-HIGHER-ORDER-PROOF-CORE-20261025/r1 research representation.
Initial author: /root/higher_order_proof_core_astra_r1; requested gpt-6-astra/medium,
observed model/effort UNKNOWN. Primary /root repairs and integrates after author
STOP; the outcome records final authorship and independent review. No descendants.
Production authority: none. The operational paper is a proposal/target; the
2026-10-07 complete-Call definition §1 records permission for legitimate research
definitions, not adoption of this representation as compiler architecture.

The parent RESPONSE-ENCODING-1 / ENV-CALLABLE-1 lacked a callable constructor in
its formal Value sort. The candidate removes that specific representational
obstruction by constructing a new callable type and actual lambda/wrap values.
Every Original.Val/Comp and TypedCall.Value/Comp/Adapter/Function constructor is
mapped structurally. No old term is retained behind an opaque original opcode.
The full parent, native readback and operational safety remain OPEN.

## Syntax and quantifiers

`HigherOrderSyntax.lean` retains every old type constructor, all eight literal
domains and their exact payload representations, variables, delay, injections,
single-child intersection/top values and all seven Original computations. It
adds the existing Call view/scope/expose/request/fail nodes, lambda/wrap values,
and dynamicCall. Request's continuation binds its operation instance's response
type. The type language can place callable types beneath thunk/union/intersection
and in operation instances. The value, computation and adapter syntax is mutually
inductive; all typing judgments are defined afterwards.

Value-entry lambda binds A; computation-entry lambda binds Thunk A. Both retain
receipt, annotated input/body/result types, body and result consumer. Wrap keeps
the input adapter c→a and output adapter b→d around an a→b function. DynamicCall
accepts a thunk carrier. This fixes a research typing interface without asserting
an execution rule or operational equivalence for the new constructor.

`ContextEmbedding old new` quantifies over every old lookup fact. The mutual
Original and TypedCall preservation proofs quantify over arbitrary old terms,
old typing derivations and target contexts satisfying that relation. Closed
Original nodes embed under any target context using the empty lookup relation;
binders use `extend_embedding`. The Function theorem quantifies over every old
FunctionTyped derivation and every target context. No original constructor,
source-domain restriction or independent continuation quantifier is discarded.
This is one-way typing preservation, not reflection or full conservativity.

## Metadata boundary

Paths retain component lists, port kinds and translated endpoint types;
occurrences retain identities and paths. Operation instances retain operation
identity, ordered type arguments and both payload/response types. Receipt slots
and profiles retain order, identity and typed paths. Adapter metadata retains
all path correspondences and captured occurrences. Interface-port metadata also
has a structural map.

PathRule is a Prop in the accepted input. `embedPathRule` translates its proof
into a new Prop proof. It does not eliminate that proof into a data-valued map
identity. In particular the old permissive adapterMap rule remains permissive;
this work cannot prove that a mappingIdentity absent from runtime data can be
reconstructed. Syntax is **typing-proof-free**, not entirely proof-free. The old
Adapter.typed field is omitted from syntax and consumed solely to construct the
new extrinsic AdapterTyped derivation. The retained PathRule metadata neither
contains a typing judgment nor creates a typing-definition cycle.

## Parent application

`embedFunction_typed` constructs a ValueTyped callable from an old FunctionTyped
proof. `function_as_argument` and `call_with_function_argument` use it in the
actual new delayed argument and dynamicCall constructors.
`request_callable_response` constructs a request that binds and returns a
callable-typed response. `function_cell` pushes the embedded function into the
existing generic NativeClosureEnvironment.Store, proves the actual current cell
equality and supplies its callable typing derivation.

`read_embedding` preserves the exact old selected cell address while mapping the
current store pointwise. `read_embedding_typed` combines that equation with the
accepted `successful_read_typed` theorem. `captured_value_typed` applies the
accepted `realized_substitution_typed` supplier to each represented context index;
`captured_body_typed` applies its actual successful capture and closed-body
construction before embedding. Both keep successful realization and CellsTyped
as explicit original premises. Nothing claims that arbitrary native closures
already satisfy those premises, or that old stores already represent new
callable values. Generic new callable storage and old represented-read transport
are two separate constructions whose native connection is still open.

## Remaining source obligations and reuse

Accepted CoreSyntax typing and CallEnvironmentRealization supply precisely their
existing domains. CoreSubstitution's bind/request lifting is reused through
close_body, without reproving lookup or assuming a new substitution rule. The
NativeClosureEnvironment.Store remains generic; no machine fields change.
Historical literal readback is not extended to callable readback by analogy.
No failure is dismissed by a narrower theorem; no new source restriction,
Simple-sub bypass or production implementation is introduced.

Luna/source intake owns ENV-LAYOUT-1 (resolved free-variable order and binder
indices from source Lambda/Name/Apply), ENV-CELL-VALUE-1 (current native Value
encoding), ENV-GRAPH-1 (recursive cell/closure graphs), ENV-CALLABLE-1's remaining

import YulangClosure.HigherOrderRecAllocation

/-! Candidate typed observations of the actual higher-order graph. Projection
is used only for the decreasing rank. Bodies and data fields are not unfolded;
transparent evidence is retained with its own types. -/
namespace YulangClosure.HigherOrderGraph
open HigherOrder (Ty Context emptyContext extend ViewOccurrence ReceiptTemplate)

variable {R : Type}

/-- A finite typed observation of the transparent spine. The two premises of
`both` remain separate. A wrap retains its inner and outer callable types and
both adapters, even when these types differ. Genuine data/code introductions
retain their original typing derivations and stop observation. -/
inductive ObservedTyped (graph : Graph R) (xi : R → Ty) : Value R Empty → Ty → Prop where
  | ref (r) : ObservedTyped graph xi (graph r) (xi r) → ObservedTyped graph xi (.ref r) (xi r)
  | unit : ObservedTyped graph xi .unit (.base .unit)
  | bool : ObservedTyped graph xi (.bool v) (.base .bool)
  | int : ObservedTyped graph xi (.int v) (.base .int)
  | floatBits : ObservedTyped graph xi (.floatBits v) (.base .float)
  | string : ObservedTyped graph xi (.string v) (.base .string)
  | bytes : ObservedTyped graph xi (.bytes v) (.base .bytes)
  | path : ObservedTyped graph xi (.path v) (.base .path)
  | char : ObservedTyped graph xi (.char v) (.base .char)
  | delay : CompTyped xi emptyTy emptyContext body a → ObservedTyped graph xi (.delay body) (.thunk a)
  | inLeft : ValueTyped xi emptyTy emptyContext v a → ObservedTyped graph xi (.inLeft v) (.union a b)
  | inRight : ValueTyped xi emptyTy emptyContext v b → ObservedTyped graph xi (.inRight v) (.union a b)
  | both : ObservedTyped graph xi v a → ObservedTyped graph xi v b →
      ObservedTyped graph xi (.both v) (.intersection a b)
  | top : ObservedTyped graph xi v a → ObservedTyped graph xi (.top v) .top
  | view : ObservedTyped graph xi v a → ObservedTyped graph xi (.view v occurrence) a
  | lambdaValue : CompTyped xi emptyTy (extend emptyContext a) body b →
      AdapterTyped xi emptyTy emptyContext consumer b r →
      ObservedTyped graph xi (.lambda .value receipt a b r body consumer) (.callable a r)
  | lambdaComputation : CompTyped xi emptyTy (extend emptyContext (.thunk a)) body b →
      AdapterTyped xi emptyTy emptyContext consumer b r →
      ObservedTyped graph xi (.lambda .computation receipt a b r body consumer) (.callable a r)
  | wrap : ObservedTyped graph xi f (.callable a b) →
      AdapterTyped xi emptyTy emptyContext input c a → AdapterTyped xi emptyTy emptyContext output b d →
      ObservedTyped graph xi (.wrap f input output) (.callable c d)

variable {graph : Graph R} {xi : R → Ty}

theorem ObservedTyped.typed (h : ObservedTyped graph xi v a) :
    ValueTyped xi emptyTy emptyContext v a := by
  induction h with
  | ref r _ _ => exact .ref r
  | unit => exact .unit
  | bool => exact .bool
  | int => exact .int
  | floatBits => exact .floatBits
  | string => exact .string
  | bytes => exact .bytes
  | path => exact .path
  | char => exact .char
  | delay h => exact .delay h
  | inLeft h => exact .inLeft h
  | inRight h => exact .inRight h
  | both _ _ ih ik => exact .both ih ik
  | top _ ih => exact .top ih
  | view _ ih => exact .view ih
  | lambdaValue h k => exact .lambdaValue h k
  | lambdaComputation h k => exact .lambdaComputation h k
  | wrap _ i o ih => exact .wrap ih i o

/-- Structural descent handles arbitrary finite wrapper syntax between graph
edges. The reference supplier is required only at the actual frontier. -/
theorem observe_from_references (h : ValueTyped xi emptyTy emptyContext v a)
    (refs : ∀ r, nextValue v = some r → ObservedTyped graph xi (.ref r) (xi r)) :
    ObservedTyped graph xi v a := by
  cases h with
  | ref r => exact refs r rfl
  | recvar e => exact Empty.elim e
  | var h => cases h
  | unit => exact .unit
  | bool => exact .bool
  | int => exact .int
  | floatBits => exact .floatBits
  | string => exact .string
  | bytes => exact .bytes
  | path => exact .path
  | char => exact .char
  | delay h => exact .delay h
  | inLeft h => exact .inLeft h
  | inRight h => exact .inRight h
  | both h k => exact .both (observe_from_references h refs) (observe_from_references k refs)
  | top h => exact .top (observe_from_references h refs)
  | view h => exact .view (observe_from_references h refs)
  | lambdaValue h k => exact .lambdaValue h k
  | lambdaComputation h k => exact .lambdaComputation h k
  | wrap h i o => exact .wrap (observe_from_references h refs) i o

/-- Actual reference lookup plus the accepted guard derive finite observation;
no canonical-value or typing oracle for projected terminal units is used. -/
theorem typed_observation (hg : WellTyped graph xi)
    (guard : GuardedValueGraph.Guarded (projectGraph graph))
    (h : ValueTyped xi emptyTy emptyContext v a) : ObservedTyped graph xi v a := by
  have aux : ∀ n (v : Value R Empty) a,
      ValueTyped xi emptyTy emptyContext v a →
      (∀ r, nextValue v = some r → guard.rank r < n) → ObservedTyped graph xi v a := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
        intro v a hv hb
        apply observe_from_references hv
        intro r hr
        exact False.elim (Nat.not_lt_zero _ (hb r hr))
    | succ n ih =>
        intro v a hv hb
        apply observe_from_references hv
        intro r hr
        apply ObservedTyped.ref r
        apply ih (graph r) (xi r) (hg r)
        intro s hs
        exact Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le
          (guard.decrease r s ((projection_edge graph r s).mpr hs))
          (Nat.le_of_lt_succ (hb r hr))
  exact aux guard.ceiling v a h (fun r _ => guard.bound r)

/-- Raw finite reference/view lookup. `here` retains the actual value, and
suppliers below determine its required introduction shape. No typing premise
occurs in this relation. Wrapper entry is not erased by this lookup. -/
inductive Head (graph : Graph R) : Value R Empty → Value R Empty → Prop where
  | here (v) : Head graph v v
  | ref : Head graph (graph r) w → Head graph (.ref r) w
  | view : Head graph v w → Head graph (.view v occurrence) w

theorem thunk_observation_of_eq (h : ObservedTyped graph xi v t) (ht : t = .thunk a) :
    ∃ body, Head graph v (.delay body) ∧ CompTyped xi emptyTy emptyContext body a := by
  revert ht
  induction h with
  | ref r h ih =>
      intro ht
      obtain ⟨body, hh, ht⟩ := ih ht
      exact ⟨body, .ref hh, ht⟩
  | view h ih =>
      intro ht
      obtain ⟨body, hh, ht⟩ := ih ht
      exact ⟨body, .view hh, ht⟩
  | delay h =>
      intro ht
      cases ht
      exact ⟨_, .here _, h⟩
  | unit => intro ht; cases ht
  | bool => intro ht; cases ht
  | int => intro ht; cases ht
  | floatBits => intro ht; cases ht
  | string => intro ht; cases ht
  | bytes => intro ht; cases ht
  | path => intro ht; cases ht
  | char => intro ht; cases ht
  | inLeft h => intro ht; cases ht
  | inRight h => intro ht; cases ht
  | both h k ih ik => intro ht; cases ht
  | top h ih => intro ht; cases ht
  | lambdaValue h k => intro ht; cases ht
  | lambdaComputation h k => intro ht; cases ht
  | wrap h i o ih => intro ht; cases ht

theorem thunk_observation (h : ObservedTyped graph xi v (.thunk a)) :
    ∃ body, Head graph v (.delay body) ∧ CompTyped xi emptyTy emptyContext body a :=
  thunk_observation_of_eq h rfl

inductive CallableTerminal (xi : R → Ty) : Value R Empty → Ty → Ty → Prop where
  | lambdaValue : CompTyped xi emptyTy (extend emptyContext a) body b →
      AdapterTyped xi emptyTy emptyContext consumer b r →
      CallableTerminal xi (.lambda .value receipt a b r body consumer) a r
  | lambdaComputation : CompTyped xi emptyTy (extend emptyContext (.thunk a)) body b →
      AdapterTyped xi emptyTy emptyContext consumer b r →
      CallableTerminal xi (.lambda .computation receipt a b r body consumer) a r
  | wrap : ValueTyped xi emptyTy emptyContext f (.callable a b) →
      AdapterTyped xi emptyTy emptyContext input c a → AdapterTyped xi emptyTy emptyContext output b d →
      CallableTerminal xi (.wrap f input output) c d

theorem callable_observation_of_eq (h : ObservedTyped graph xi v t) (ht : t = .callable a b) :
    ∃ w, Head graph v w ∧ CallableTerminal xi w a b := by
  revert ht
  induction h with
  | ref r h ih =>
      intro ht
      obtain ⟨w, hh, ht⟩ := ih ht
      exact ⟨w, .ref hh, ht⟩
  | view h ih =>
      intro ht
      obtain ⟨w, hh, ht⟩ := ih ht
      exact ⟨w, .view hh, ht⟩
  | lambdaValue h k =>
      intro ht
      cases ht
      exact ⟨_, .here _, .lambdaValue h k⟩
  | lambdaComputation h k =>
      intro ht
      cases ht
      exact ⟨_, .here _, .lambdaComputation h k⟩
  | wrap h i o ih =>
      intro ht
      cases ht
      exact ⟨_, .here _, .wrap h.typed i o⟩
  | unit => intro ht; cases ht
  | bool => intro ht; cases ht
  | int => intro ht; cases ht
  | floatBits => intro ht; cases ht
  | string => intro ht; cases ht
  | bytes => intro ht; cases ht
  | path => intro ht; cases ht
  | char => intro ht; cases ht
  | delay h => intro ht; cases ht
  | inLeft h => intro ht; cases ht
  | inRight h => intro ht; cases ht
  | both h k ih ik => intro ht; cases ht
  | top h ih => intro ht; cases ht

theorem callable_observation (h : ObservedTyped graph xi v (.callable a b)) :
    ∃ w, Head graph v w ∧ CallableTerminal xi w a b :=
  callable_observation_of_eq h rfl

theorem union_observation_of_eq (h : ObservedTyped graph xi v t) (ht : t = .union a b) :
    (∃ w, Head graph v (.inLeft w) ∧ ValueTyped xi emptyTy emptyContext w a) ∨
    (∃ w, Head graph v (.inRight w) ∧ ValueTyped xi emptyTy emptyContext w b) := by
  revert ht
  induction h with
  | ref r h ih =>
      intro ht
      rcases ih ht with ⟨w, hh, ht⟩ | ⟨w, hh, ht⟩
      · exact .inl ⟨w, .ref hh, ht⟩
      · exact .inr ⟨w, .ref hh, ht⟩
  | view h ih =>
      intro ht
      rcases ih ht with ⟨w, hh, ht⟩ | ⟨w, hh, ht⟩
      · exact .inl ⟨w, .view hh, ht⟩
      · exact .inr ⟨w, .view hh, ht⟩
  | inLeft h =>
      intro ht
      cases ht
      exact .inl ⟨_, .here _, h⟩
  | inRight h =>
      intro ht
      cases ht
      exact .inr ⟨_, .here _, h⟩
  | unit => intro ht; cases ht
  | bool => intro ht; cases ht
  | int => intro ht; cases ht
  | floatBits => intro ht; cases ht
  | string => intro ht; cases ht
  | bytes => intro ht; cases ht
  | path => intro ht; cases ht
  | char => intro ht; cases ht
  | delay h => intro ht; cases ht
  | both h k ih ik => intro ht; cases ht
  | top h ih => intro ht; cases ht
  | lambdaValue h k => intro ht; cases ht
  | lambdaComputation h k => intro ht; cases ht
  | wrap h i o ih => intro ht; cases ht

theorem union_observation (h : ObservedTyped graph xi v (.union a b)) :
    (∃ w, Head graph v (.inLeft w) ∧ ValueTyped xi emptyTy emptyContext w a) ∨
    (∃ w, Head graph v (.inRight w) ∧ ValueTyped xi emptyTy emptyContext w b) :=
  union_observation_of_eq h rfl

theorem intersection_observation_of_eq (h : ObservedTyped graph xi v t) (ht : t = .intersection a b) :
    ∃ w, Head graph v (.both w) ∧ ValueTyped xi emptyTy emptyContext w a ∧
      ValueTyped xi emptyTy emptyContext w b := by
  revert ht
  induction h with
  | ref r h ih =>
      intro ht
      obtain ⟨w, hh, ha, hb⟩ := ih ht
      exact ⟨w, .ref hh, ha, hb⟩
  | view h ih =>
      intro ht
      obtain ⟨w, hh, ha, hb⟩ := ih ht
      exact ⟨w, .view hh, ha, hb⟩
  | both h k ih ik =>
      intro ht
      cases ht
      exact ⟨_, .here _, h.typed, k.typed⟩
  | unit => intro ht; cases ht
  | bool => intro ht; cases ht
  | int => intro ht; cases ht
  | floatBits => intro ht; cases ht
  | string => intro ht; cases ht
  | bytes => intro ht; cases ht
  | path => intro ht; cases ht
  | char => intro ht; cases ht
  | delay h => intro ht; cases ht
  | inLeft h => intro ht; cases ht
  | inRight h => intro ht; cases ht
  | top h ih => intro ht; cases ht
  | lambdaValue h k => intro ht; cases ht
  | lambdaComputation h k => intro ht; cases ht
  | wrap h i o ih => intro ht; cases ht

theorem intersection_observation (h : ObservedTyped graph xi v (.intersection a b)) :
    ∃ w, Head graph v (.both w) ∧ ValueTyped xi emptyTy emptyContext w a ∧
      ValueTyped xi emptyTy emptyContext w b :=
  intersection_observation_of_eq h rfl

theorem top_observation_of_eq (h : ObservedTyped graph xi v t) (ht : t = .top) :
    ∃ w a, Head graph v (.top w) ∧ ValueTyped xi emptyTy emptyContext w a := by
  revert ht

      intro ht
      obtain ⟨w, a, hh, ht⟩ := ih ht

      intro ht
      obtain ⟨w, a, hh, ht⟩ := ih ht
      exact ⟨w, a, .view hh, ht⟩
  | top h ih =>
      intro ht
      cases ht

  | unit => intro ht; cases ht
  | bool => intro ht; cases ht
  | int => intro ht; cases ht

theorem ObservedTyped.bottom_empty_of_eq (h : ObservedTyped graph xi v t)
    (ht : t = .bottom) : False := by
  revert ht
  induction h with
  | ref r h ih => intro ht; exact ih ht
  | view h ih => intro ht; exact ih ht
  | unit => intro ht; cases ht
